tbesh_html:
1) to tread out, thresh
1a) (Qal) to tread on, trample on, thresh
1b) (Niphal) to be trampled down
1c) (Hophal) to be threshed

strongs_1890.derivation: or דּוֹשׁ; or דִּישׁ; a primitive root;
strongs_1890.kjv_def: break, tear, thresh, tread out (down), at grass (Jeremiah 50:11, by mistake for H1877 (דֶּשֶׁא)).
